bilingual.notes: Bilingual Education Extension: add-on only, attached to a valid base certificate. Approved program requires coursework in six content areas, ≥50 clock hours of college-supervised field experience, and the Bilingual Education Assessment (BEA), which doubles as the language-proficiency instrument for the language other than English.

eld.notes: Branded ESOL in OTI certification listings and TESOL in higher-ed program names. Standalone classroom-teacher certificate (CST 116 ESOL) plus supplementary pathway for already-certified teachers. Programs (Fall 2024+) require ≥100 clock hours of field experience and ≥70 school days of student teaching with ELL students. 12 LOTE semester hours required as coursework precondition but not as a target-language proficiency demonstration.

sei.notes: No universal SEI/EL credential mandate. CR Part 154 requires general classroom teachers of ELLs to dedicate 15% of CTLE clock hours to language acquisition addressing the needs of ELLs — a continuing-education obligation, not a credential mandate.
